sources.sourceTitleOriginal: Pokémon not available yet - Hisuian Goodra
sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: Hisuian Goodra exact page 明確顯示 Pokémon not available yet；此明確否定只套用 #706 Hisuian Goodra，不反向推定 #705 Hisuian Sliggoo。
Available Shadow Pokémon roster 正面列出 Inkay/Malamar、Helioptile/Heliolisk、Tyrunt/Tyrantrum、Amaura/Aurorus，共本批 8 個 ordinary exact forms。
GO Tour: Kalos Global 記錄 Mega Malamar 作為活動新 Pokémon，並確認 Honedge/Doublade/Aegislash 已在 2026 活動週期實際出現。
Purified 僅從同 exact form 已確認 Shadow 加官方淨化機制推導。

boundary: Aegislash Shield and Blade/Sword are independently positive in the current Kalos roster. Hisuian form identity or battle stats do not imply release: Hisuian Goodra has an explicit not-available page, while Hisuian Sliggoo stays UNKNOWN because no equally strong exact release conclusion was found. Shadow/Purified are positive only for eight current-roster ordinary forms. Mega Malamar and the three Dynamax identities are positive; Mega Barbaracle, Dragalge and Hawlucha are explicit negative roster rows. No other special state is inferred from absence.
